targets.behavior: Computes four target-view corner rays, projects valid rays onto z=0, compares them with camera bounds when arg1 is zero or blast-zone bounds otherwise, and translates target position and interest by the same XY correction. Opposing violations are averaged, so this is a best-effort correction rather than a guarantee that an oversized view fits.
targets.inputs: target_fov, target_interest, target_position, cm_803BCB64.aspect, cm_WorldForward, arg1 and stage boundary accessors
targets.state_and_callbacks: Writes transform target_position and target_interest only if a violation mask is nonzero; ignores rays with z >= -0.001.
targets.uncertainty: No exact-fit guarantee; the branch comment says arg1 is always zero, but that is not proof about every caller.

targets.behavior: Installs transform FOV, XY-translated interest, and XY-translated eye position on an HSD_CObj. Before setting the eye, clamps its Y against a lower bound returned by one of six stage-specific functions selected by stage_info.grkind.
targets.inputs: cobj, transform fov/interest/position, game_camera.translation.x/y and stage_info.grkind
targets.state_and_callbacks: Calls HSD_CObjSetFov, HSD_CObjSetInterest and HSD_CObjSetEyePosition; leaves the input transform unchanged.
targets.uncertainty: Foreign stage callees are only known here as providers of the compared Y bound; their rendered pause/floor names are not proof.

targets.behavior: Updates game_camera.x2BC from slot-0 player controller vertical substick input when gm_8016B41C() is nonzero and x2C0 is positive. Uses a 0.85 threshold, x2BA reload/countdown and configured fallback increment, then clamps x2BC between xDC and xD8.
targets.inputs: gm_8016B41C(), x2C0, Player_GetPlayerId(0), HSD_PadCopyStatus, cm_803BCCA0 xD4/xD8/xDC/xE0/xE4
targets.state_and_callbacks: Writes x2BA and x2BC; strong input reloads x2BA, neutral input waits for countdown before using xE4.
targets.uncertainty: Single-player meaning of gm_8016B41C remains a foreign-family question.

targets.behavior: Applies zoom multiplier m=game_camera.x2BC to a supplied target transform around the accepted slot-0 camera subject, with a slot-1 Sandbag fallback. Sets interest to subject+(old_interest-subject)*m*m and eye to new_interest+normalize(old_eye-new_interest)*(x2C0*m).
targets.inputs: transform, x2BC/x2C0, player entities and camera subjects, eligibility/bounds results and ftLib_8008732C
targets.state_and_callbacks: No change when m is exactly one or neither candidate qualifies; otherwise replaces both target vectors.
targets.uncertainty: The normalized direction uses the newly changed interest, not the original eye-to-interest direction. Exact ftLib predicates require family review.

targets.behavior: Updates primary and copied gameplay camera transforms through bounds/FOV calculations, conditionally recalculates and bounds-corrects target vectors, caches unzoomed target distance, applies zoom and stage tracking smoothing, invokes quake updates on the primary transform, and updates average stage camera width.
targets.inputs: Unused arg0; both singleton transforms, camera tuning, stage smoothing/bounds and fighter-depth guard
targets.state_and_callbacks: Helpers update x2C0 only when x2BC==1, smooth both transforms, apply quake calls only to primary, and restart the width accumulator after count>1000.
targets.uncertainty: The depth guard skips Camera_80029CF8 and Camera_8002A768, not the preceding bounds/FOV/depth calculations.

targets.behavior: Fills CameraInputs from a selected controller. Selector 5 clears all fields; selector 4 independently chooses the first main stick and substick whose absolute axis exceeds 0.85, or zeros each pair when none qualifies; ordinary selectors copy one pad. Buttons come from gm_GetButtonsPressed/Triggered with the selected source.
targets.inputs: Output CameraInputs pointer, slot, copied pad states and processed button accessors
targets.state_and_callbacks: Writes all six fields without modifying pad state. Aggregate stick pairs can come from different controllers.
targets.uncertainty: The OR semantics of gm button aggregation require its owner; this body demonstrates argument 4, not the implementation of the accessor.

targets.behavior: Steps the camera subject selector by a signed increment, using sentinel 10 between player slots 5 and 0 and recursively skipping slots whose Player_GetEntity result is NULL. Returns sentinel 10 without an entity lookup.
targets.inputs: slot and arg1 signed step; Player_GetEntity
targets.state_and_callbacks: Returns next selector; no singleton writes. Sentinel 10 moves to 0 for a positive step and 5 for a negative step.
targets.uncertainty: Normal +/-1 usage is shown in controls; a zero step at an empty ordinary slot recurses without progress.

targets.behavior: Changes pause_eye_distance by zoom_amt times a length-dependent configured rate, clamps it to x2D0.unk28/unk2C, and rebuilds pause_eye_offset at that distance. An offset shorter than one substitutes a direction and starts stored distance at ten.
targets.inputs: zoom_amt, pause_eye_offset/distance, x9C/xA0 and x2D0 depth limits
targets.state_and_callbacks: Writes pause_eye_distance and pause_eye_offset, including normalization/clamping for a zero input.
targets.uncertainty: Camera_PauseZoom is attested in the immediately preceding canonical comment; renderer reports name_collision.

targets.behavior: Rebuilds right and up basis vectors. When forward.y exceeds 0.999 or is below -0.999, snaps forward to the corresponding vertical axis, restores up from pause_up, and returns +1 or -1; otherwise returns zero.
targets.inputs: Mutable forward/up/right Vec3 pointers and retained pause_up
targets.state_and_callbacks: Always computes normalized right=up cross forward and normalized up=forward cross right; mutates forward only at a pole.
targets.uncertainty: Assumes usable input basis; no explicit zero-cross-product recovery is present.

targets.behavior: Moves pause_eye_offset along input-scaled camera-up and negative-right directions, then normalizes it to pause_eye_distance. Builds and stores pause_up, and suppresses horizontal input plus outward vertical input when the pole helper returns a nonzero sign.
targets.inputs: x/y orbit inputs, pause_eye_offset/distance/up, world-up and xBC/xC0 rate coefficients
targets.state_and_callbacks: Writes pause_up and pause_eye_offset; short starting offset resets stored distance to ten and substitutes forward basis.
targets.uncertainty: Camera_PauseRotate is attested in the preceding canonical comment; short-offset handling does not replace pos, so no unconditional nondegeneracy guarantee.

targets.behavior: Pans game_camera.x314 in the camera-relative up and negative-right directions using each input times eye_distance*xB4+xB8. Derives the basis from negated pause_eye_offset and the pole helper.
targets.inputs: farg0 horizontal, farg1 vertical, pause_eye_offset, cm_803B73DC, xB4/xB8
targets.state_and_callbacks: Adds only nonzero-axis movements to x314; short offset substitutes forward, effective distance one, and stored pause_eye_distance one.
targets.uncertainty: The sign of rate coefficients is not established here, so speed increasing with distance is not unconditional.

targets.behavior: Decodes the selected controller into subject cycling, zoom, pan and orbit operations. Triggered R/L changes x304 and resets offsets/up/distance; D-pad pans, X/Y or main-stick Y zooms, A redirects the main stick to pan, and substick input orbits.
targets.inputs: x305 input selector, x304 subject selector, CameraInputs, x32C and tuning coefficients
targets.state_and_callbacks: Returns immediately for x305==5. Uses strict 0.125 analog dead zones. Subject 10 gets triple initial distance and world-X/Y movement; other subjects use camera-relative panning.
targets.uncertainty: The special movement helper sets distance to one only when eye-offset length is below one; it does not generally clamp existing distance.

targets.behavior: Calls an optional constraint-record callback, clamps x308 to XYZ bounds, clamps x308+x314 to the same bounds and reconstructs x314, then conditionally rotates pause_eye_offset to correct pitch and yaw limit violations.
targets.inputs: Camera_x2D0 pointer, optional callback, XYZ min/max, angle_up/down/left/right, x308/x314 and pause basis
targets.state_and_callbacks: Callback runs before constraints. Pitch correction precedes yaw calculation; rotation axes are computed before either rotation. No mode or timer assignment appears in this body.
targets.uncertainty: Do not promise independently exact final pitch/yaw: the second rotation uses the precomputed cross2 axis. Callback side effects are not bounded by this body.

targets.behavior: Updates a subject-relative controllable camera: processes controls, retries subject resolution, clamps base/offset/orbit state, forms target interest and eye, approaches current vectors using x84 and FOV using x88 toward x32C, then invokes Camera_UpdateQuakes and Camera_ApplyQuake.
targets.inputs: Unused arg0; x304/x308/x314, pause_eye_offset, transform, x32C, x84/x88 and subject-resolution helpers
targets.state_and_callbacks: Constraints run before target construction and smoothing. Final calls are quake helpers, not a second geometric bounds correction.
targets.uncertainty: CAMERA_FREE table registration and player-facing mode descriptions need TU lead or foreign-header evidence.
